notes: Two-word capitalized run exceeding the bare class word is correctly a Name-only symbol with no modifier genus, and "narrow"/"descending" are correctly left unfused as incidental description with the participle kept in adjective form. The kind word inside the name ("Stair") yields no type atom here; Names-and-casing licenses one, but the copular predicate already supplies the kind, so this is at most a licensed-not-emitted atom.
